name: Springer Nature
summary: Metadata and abstracts for Springer Nature journal articles, book chapters and protocols, plus open-access full text in JATS, from the Springer Nature APIs.

api_key.description: API key from the API Management page of a dev.springernature.com account; sent as the api_key query parameter.

notes: Basic (free) plan: 100 requests a minute and 500 a day per API; Premium raises it (Meta and Metadata 300/min, 10,000/day).
Page with s (start, from 1) and p (page size, default 10). Max p: Meta API 25 on Basic, 100 on Premium; Open Access API 20.
Which query constraints work depends on the plan; Premium-only filters fail on a Basic key.

endpoints.name: Search article and chapter metadata
endpoints.summary: Versioned metadata (title, DOI, authors, abstract, journal or book, subjects, links) for matching documents, with facets.

q.description: Query of constraint:argument pairs separated by spaces (doi:, keyword:, subject:, journal:, title:, name:, year:, issn:, isbn:, type:Book|Journal, openaccess:true...); quote multi-word arguments with %22. Some constraints are Premium-only.

p.description: Results per page (default 10; max 25 Basic, 100 Premium).

endpoints.name: Search open-access metadata
endpoints.summary: Metadata for matching open-access articles and chapters.

q.description: Query of constraint:argument pairs separated by spaces (doi:, keyword:, subject:, journal:, title:, name:, year:, issn:, isbn:, type:Book|Journal, openaccess:true...); quote multi-word arguments with %22. Some constraints are Premium-only.

endpoints.name: Get open-access full text
endpoints.summary: Full text of matching open-access articles and chapters as JATS XML, where available.

q.description: Query of constraint:argument pairs separated by spaces (doi:, keyword:, subject:, journal:, title:, name:, year:, issn:, isbn:, type:Book|Journal, openaccess:true...); quote multi-word arguments with %22. Some constraints are Premium-only.

notes: Returns XML; narrow q to a doi: to get one document.
